author: sensiblesally
quote: A vulgar, boring, heavily flawed, cheaply made game. You can’t even pick up car keys found on the living room side-table in some rich person’s broken-into-house to unlock the door of some yellow supercar parked in their garage driveway. Total weak-sauce, fake, trash. Although, a lot of the environment looks somewhat 4k, simulators are more interesting and fun. Actually, a Nancy Drew mystery game is way more interesting and definitely less trashy than this gtaVI woke slop. GTA is realism in the worst possible way. They even give your character “bad person” ratings when you throw a stranger’s dead dog that you shot onto the ground. Yet, you can run people over in the street with no in-game reprimanding? Total face-palm. Total yawn. Rather play Arkham on PS3. I ought to rate this game at 0 in order to counter the paid-for green AI reviews.
